request.query: coefficient of multivariate polynomial Taylor translation equals evaluated Hasse derivative

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff_one
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff 1 = Polynomial.eval r (Polynomial.derivative f)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R), ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff 0 = Polynomial.eval r f

items.name: HasFPowerSeriesAt.deriv
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 𝕜 F} {f : 𝕜 → F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasFPowerSeriesAt f p x → deriv f x = (p 1) fun x => 1

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ),
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (MvPowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f • (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.leadingCoeff_taylor
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R), ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).leadingCoeff = f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → R → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R
